svg.title: Poultry farmer — Woman
svg.desc: A fictional woman working as poultry farmer, wearing coveralls and a peaked work cap. Visible work cue: Three separately outlined eggs sit above a shallow collection tray. The person is on the left, with the work cue on the right. Occupational headgear: a peaked work cap.
